title: Choosing a Study Space
label: 問4
passageHtml:
Where Should We Create a New Study Space?

Student A: The unused music room is quiet and has large windows. However, it is far from the main classrooms.

Student B: The area beside the cafeteria is central and easy to find, but it becomes noisy at lunch.

Student C: We could divide the old computer room. It already has desks and power outlets, although renovation would cost more.

Student D: An outdoor covered area would be inexpensive and pleasant in spring, but it would be uncomfortable in winter.

School priorityImportance
Quiet throughout the dayHigh
Low initial costMedium
Access to electricityHigh
Near the cafeteriaLow

questions.question: Which proposal best satisfies both high-priority conditions?
questions.evidence: The old computer room has desks and power outlets; unlike the cafeteria area, no daytime noise problem is mentioned.
questions.reason_ja: 静かさと電源の両条件を最も満たす案を選びます。

questions.question: What is the main weakness of Student B’s proposal?
questions.reason_ja: 昼休みに騒がしくなることが弱点です。

questions.question: Which proposal focuses most clearly on seasonal comfort?
questions.evidence: pleasant in spring, but ... uncomfortable in winter.
questions.reason_ja: springとwinterを対比して季節による快適性を論じています。

questions.question: Why might the school reject Student A’s proposal?
questions.evidence: it is far from the main classrooms.
questions.reason_ja: 立地上の不便さが明示されています。
